cover.desc: Full color, cheap light, no warmth anywhere. The external walkway of a low 1970s apartment block at night — bare concrete, a green-painted steel stair, a strip of buzzing fluorescent under the balcony, other people's windows lit yellow further along, an air-conditioning unit, a bicycle chained to the rail. Itsuki stands in an open doorway at the top of the stair in a stretched grey sweatshirt and house sandals, a bulging bin bag hanging from each hand, hair flat, face doing absolutely nothing — caught in the middle of a chore in a place nobody was supposed to see. At the bottom of the stair, small in the frame, hands empty at her sides, Nagi — in her navy school blazer and grey skirt, bag on her shoulder, still in the daytime clothes the reader has only ever seen her wear at school. NOT the happi. She is the wrong person in the wrong clothes at the wrong end of town. The composition is Chapter 1's reveal turned exactly around.

chars.name: sensei
chars.expression: brisk, past caring
chars.pose: at the front with a stack of pale green forms

panels.bg: classroom, morning, students at desks
panels.action: Wednesday.

chars.name: gonda
chars.expression: >_<, hair on end, tiny body huge head, form crumpled in both fists
chars.pose: chibi, on his knees on his own desk

chars.name: aya
chars.expression: chibi, sparkling, offering advice with total confidence

panels.bg: chaos lines, starburst screentone
panels.action: The five-year plan has been outstanding since chapter seven.

dialogue.text: I HAVE NO FIVE-YEAR PLAN. I HAVE NO PLAN.

chars.name: sensei
chars.expression: hand out, unimpressed

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: easy, grinning, bag already on his shoulder

panels.bg: classroom aisle, morning light
panels.action: It is a joke and it gets a laugh and it is also a completely accurate statement.

dialogue.text: Nomura. You said tomorrow on Tuesday.
And I meant it on Tuesday.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: laughing with three other people
chars.pose: at the far side of the room

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: half-lidded, writing, not looking up

panels.bg: classroom, the full width of the room between them, hard morning light
panels.action: Six days. Neither of them has looked directly at the other in six days, and both of them are excellent at it.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: working, ordinary

panels.bg: Kotobuki-yu at 7:40pm, warm lamp, steam, a couple of pairs of shoes in the rack, the fish clock
panels.action: The building is running perfectly.

chars.name: ban
chars.expression: setting a crate down, then stopping to straighten his back with one hand on it
chars.pose: at the counter, breathing out through his nose

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: watching him do it

panels.bg: bandai counter, warm lamp, the crate on the floor
panels.action: Sixty-eight years old, and for three weeks there has been somebody tall to hand the heavy end to. Neither of them mentions it. Silent.

panels.bg: the corner of the bath hall: an empty hook on the tiled wall, and on the floor below it the blue-handled brush, lying dry beside a full bucket, exactly where it was left six days ago
panels.action: Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: looking up at the sound of the noren

panels.bg: bandai counter, warm lamp, the entrance beyond

chars.name: mio
chars.expression: thirteen, in her middle-school uniform, chin up, hands tight on her bag strap
chars.pose: standing just inside the entrance, not taking her shoes off

panels.bg: Kotobuki-yu entrance from inside, warm lamp, sandal rack, night street behind her
panels.action: She has walked four streets in the dark on her own and she is not going to let that show.

chars.name: mio
chars.expression: flat, checking a fact

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: level

panels.bg: entrance and counter, warm lamp
panels.action: She came because he isn't here.

chars.name: mio
chars.expression: businesslike, not looking up
chars.pose: taking a folded sheet out of her bag, opening it once, laying it flat on the counter

panels.bg: bandai counter, warm lamp
panels.action: She took it out of his bag herself. That is a very large thing for a thirteen-year-old to do and she has decided not to think about it.

panels.bg: a pale green careers survey form lying on the counter under the lamp. ART NOTE: layout only, no legible characters — a ruled header block, a name field, three ruled sections with generous blank space, a small date box in the corner. Every line on it is empty. The paper is soft at the folds from three weeks in a school bag.
panels.action: Nothing on it anywhere.

chars.name: mio
chars.expression: reciting, absolutely level, like reading out a stock count
chars.pose: hands back on her bag strap

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: looking at the form

panels.bg: counter, warm lamp
panels.action: Inventory.

dialogue.text: It's been in his bag three weeks.

chars.name: mio
chars.expression: the only crack in her all evening, and it is very small
chars.pose: eyes on the counter, not on Nagi

panels.bg: counter edge, warm lamp, flat screentone
panels.action: This is the question she walked four streets in the dark to ask.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: level, not softening it, because softening it would be a lie

panels.bg: warm lamp, flat screentone
panels.action: She could make this easier. She doesn't.

chars.name: mio
chars.expression: taking it, filing it, nodding once

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: watching her take it

panels.bg: entrance and counter, warm lamp, the sandals squared at the counter base
panels.action: The answer is no everywhere. She had suspected as much and now it is confirmed and that is worse.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not looking at her, sliding it across
chars.pose: setting a bottle of milk on the counter without comment

chars.name: mio
chars.expression: caught completely off guard
chars.pose: hands still on her bag strap

panels.bg: counter, cold case humming, warm lamp
panels.action: Ban does it with towels. Aya did it with rice. It is the only grammar anyone on this street has for it.

chars.name: mio
chars.expression: not knowing what to do with being given something, which runs in the family

panels.bg: counter, warm lamp
panels.action: Silent.

chars.name: mio
chars.expression: stopped, looking
chars.pose: half-turned in the entrance, bottle in one hand

panels.bg: the rest area seen from the entrance: the tatami bench, the fish clock, the massage chair humming away in the corner
panels.action: This is the room her brother comes to when it is good. She has never seen it before. Silent.

chars.name: mio
chars.expression: at the noren, not turning round

panels.bg: noren, night street beyond, warm light behind her
panels.action: She does not ask for anything. She hands over coordinates, which is the only kind of asking she knows how to do.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: alone, standing exactly where she was
chars.pose: behind the counter, hands flat on the wood, looking down at the form

panels.bg: the empty changing room, warm lamp, the noren still swinging, the form lying open on the counter
panels.action: Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: n/a — hand only
chars.pose: her hand coming down flat on the form and sliding it toward her

panels.bg: the counter, the pale green form, warm lamp, split knuckles
panels.action: Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: writing four characters on a piece of card, entirely level
chars.pose: at the counter with a marker pen

panels.bg: counter, a rectangle of white card, warm lamp. ART NOTE: layout only — handwriting shapes, no legible characters.
panels.action: Thursday, 5:15pm. She writes a sign.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: n/a — hand only
chars.pose: her hand on the boiler shutdown valve, and turning it

panels.bg: boiler room, the valve, bare bulb, the gauge beginning to fall. ART NOTE: compose to match Ch.9 page 17 panel 1 exactly — same crop, same hand, same valve. That time she took her hand off it.
panels.action: Fourteen months. She has never once done this on purpose.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible — small, back turned, walking away up the street
chars.pose: school blazer, bag on her shoulder, hands empty

panels.bg: the Sakuragawa shotengai at 6:05pm. Kotobuki-yu with no noren up, no lamp on, a small white card taped inside the glass, the chimney venting nothing at all.
panels.action: She does not know how to say sorry. She knows what things cost. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: small in frame, standing at the bottom of the stair
chars.pose: school blazer, bag on her shoulder, hands empty at her sides

panels.bg: a low 1970s apartment block at 7:10pm: bare concrete walkway, green steel external stair, buzzing fluorescent strip, a bicycle chained to the rail, somebody's washing still out, other windows lit yellow. Wholly ordinary and completely unfamiliar.
panels.action: Sakuragawa five, the green block, second floor.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: unreadable, not moving toward the stair

panels.bg: the foot of the stair, fluorescent light, dark road behind
panels.action: She does not go up. Going up would require a sentence.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible — small, in the same place

panels.bg: same shot as the panel above, one hour and fifty minutes later — 9:02pm. Two of the lit windows have gone dark. She has not moved.
panels.action: In chapter one, somebody stood outside a building in the rain for four minutes and it changed everything. This takes rather longer. Silent.

panels.bg: a door opening on the second-floor walkway, warm light spilling out onto concrete

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: nothing on his face at all — hair flat, eyes tired, none of the apparatus running
chars.pose: in the doorway in a stretched grey sweatshirt and house sandals, a bulging bin bag hanging from each hand

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: looking up at him, hands empty
chars.pose: at the bottom of the stair in her school blazer

panels.bg: the concrete walkway and the green stair, fluorescent strip, night. ART NOTE: compose to answer Ch.1 page 12 — same reveal, reversed. There she was caught mid-chore and he was the one standing outside in ordinary clothes with nothing to say.
panels.action: Full page. Nobody wears the face to take the bins out.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: not moving, bags still hanging
chars.pose: at the top of the stair

panels.bg: walkway, fluorescent, night
panels.action: One word, and it comes out flat.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: level
chars.pose: taking a folded pale green sheet out of her blazer pocket and holding it out

panels.bg: the foot of the stair, fluorescent light
panels.action: She does not say anything at all. She just holds it up.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: recognising it from ten feet away, and knowing exactly how it got there
chars.pose: coming down two steps, bags still in both hands

panels.bg: green steel stair, fluorescent, night
panels.action: It is not a question.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: the grin coming up, the shoulders loosening, the whole machine spinning up
chars.pose: setting the bags down, hands going out

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not reacting in any direction

panels.bg: the bottom of the stair, concrete, fluorescent, the bin store a few metres off
panels.action: He reaches for it because he always reaches for it. It is the first thing his body does.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: mid-bit, grin still up, and something going wrong behind it

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: has not moved a muscle

panels.bg: concrete, fluorescent, night
panels.action: The sentence gets four words further and then stops in his mouth.

dialogue.text: Real money in grout, you have no—

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: the grin coming off like something falling, hand still stupidly up in the air

panels.bg: fluorescent light, concrete, flat screentone
panels.action: She has not glared at him. She has not said one word. It isn't her. He sat on a floor at four in the morning and it stopped working, and his body found out before he did. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: cold, exact, not raising her voice by one degree

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: hand coming down

panels.bg: concrete, fluorescent, the bin store, night
panels.action: The instruction voice, aimed the other way for the first time.

dialogue.text: It's been in your bag three weeks.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: quiet, reasonable, entirely sincere — this is the true thing he believes

panels.bg: concrete, fluorescent
panels.action: He is not being brave about it. To him this is simply arithmetic.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: absolutely level, and underneath it, furious

panels.bg: fluorescent light, flat screentone
panels.action: Two words. She is the one person alive who cannot be told she does not understand.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: not answering
chars.pose: standing by two bin bags on concrete

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not letting him not answer

panels.bg: the space between the stair and the bin store, fluorescent strip, a car going past somewhere out of frame
panels.action: She waits. She is extremely good at waiting. Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: eyes down, saying a number he has been carrying since he was thirteen

panels.bg: concrete, fluorescent, flat screentone
panels.action: He has done this arithmetic before. He does not have to work it out.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: nothing on her face, and the arithmetic landing behind it

panels.bg: fluorescent light, flat screentone
panels.action: Sōta is six. Nobody in the panel says what age that makes him. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: starting a sentence she has said before with a different subject in it

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: head coming up

panels.bg: concrete, fluorescent, night
panels.action: She gets seven words out.

dialogue.text: You think if you stop, it's just—

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: mouth closing, jaw setting

panels.bg: flat screentone, fluorescent
panels.action: She does not finish it. Finishing it would be about her. Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: understanding exactly how that sentence ends

panels.bg: flat screentone, fluorescent light
panels.action: He was three feet away on a floor at seventeen minutes past three in the morning. He knows the rest of it word for word. Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: no face on at all, breathing wrong, nowhere left to go
chars.pose: sitting down heavily on the second step of the green stair

panels.bg: green steel stair, concrete, fluorescent strip, two bin bags on the floor
panels.action: He does not cry. He simply runs out of places to put himself and sits down on a step. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not going to him, not touching him
chars.pose: standing where she is, three metres away

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: elbows on his knees, head down

panels.bg: the walkway, the stair, the bin store, cheap fluorescent, an ordinary residential night
panels.action: Being cared for, with no way to deflect it, and having to sit inside that. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: matter-of-fact, not making anything of it
chars.pose: bending and lifting one of the two bin bags off the concrete

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: head coming up

panels.bg: concrete, bin bags, fluorescent
panels.action: Nine chapters of him taking the heavy end. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible — back turned, small
chars.pose: carrying the bag across to the bin store in her school blazer

panels.bg: a concrete bin store under a streetlight, wire mesh, sorted bins, an ugly and entirely unromantic corner of a residential street
panels.action: She takes it to the bins. It is the least beautiful thing anybody has done in this series and it is the apology. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: level, holding the form out again
chars.pose: back in front of him, standing

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: looking up at her from the step

panels.bg: green stair, fluorescent, night
panels.action: Not go to university. Not have a future. The smallest instruction she can find.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: already turning to go, not waiting for an answer
chars.pose: form pressed into his hand, walking

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: opening his mouth

panels.bg: the foot of the stair, fluorescent, the dark road
panels.action: It is exactly how a dead man kept a building alive for fifteen years, and she does not explain that, and he does not know it.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: n/a — hands only, one plaster, a hair tie on the wrist
chars.pose: the form flattened against the concrete wall of the bin store, a biro moving on the name line

panels.bg: the pale green form against grey concrete under a streetlight, the same terrible handwriting that filled in a receipt at five in the morning. ART NOTE: handwriting shapes only, no legible characters.
panels.action: One line. She is already round the corner and does not see it. Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: not visible — small, walking up the shotengai
chars.pose: school jersey, bag on his shoulder

panels.bg: the Sakuragawa shotengai the following Thursday at 11:38pm, shutters down, and one lit doorway with the indigo noren still up
panels.action: Thursday. Nothing is announced and nothing is arranged.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible — back turned, twenty feet off
chars.pose: crouched at the far end of the bath hall, scrubbing

panels.bg: bath hall from the changing-room doorway, steam, tile grid, one lamp, a single wet footprint at the near edge of frame
panels.action: Somebody steps onto wet stone at the other end of the building.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: stopped in the doorway, the blue-handled brush already in one hand, a very small real smile

panels.bg: the changing-room doorway, steam, warm lamp
panels.action: She does not turn round, and she does not stop working, and she is not guessing. Final panel.
